fee_shadow.edges_en: A fill's time is the book observation it was priced on. Fills observed in the same second as the assessed fill do not count toward its tier, and a fill exactly 30 days old has rolled off: both edges resolve to the higher fee.
fee_shadow.edges_zh: 成交时间取其定价所依据的盘口观测时间。与被评定成交在同一秒内观测到的成交不计入其费率档，恰好 30 天前的成交已滚出窗口：两个边界都按较高的费用处理。
fee_shadow.footnote_en: First order: the same fills and sizes are kept. Lower fees would also have moved when the daily-loss breaker and the cumulative-loss latch fired (and left more cash to size from); that is not modelled.
fee_shadow.footnote_zh: 一阶近似：成交与数量保持不变。更低的费用还会改变单日亏损熔断与累计亏损锁定的触发时点（并留下更多现金用于定仓），这一影响未建模。
fee_shadow.guard_en: Display only. The official figure stays at the frozen $0+ tier; this never feeds ranking, evolution, breakers, research selection or any acceptance rule, because a volume discount rewards turnover.
fee_shadow.guard_zh: 仅供显示。官方口径仍是冻结的 $0+ 档费率；此数字不参与排名、进化、熔断、研究筛选或任何验收规则，因为成交量折扣会奖励换手。
fee_shadow.label_en: same fills, fees re-priced at the Kraken tier this slot's own paper volume would reach (first order)
fee_shadow.label_zh: 同一批成交，按本槽自身纸面成交量可达到的 Kraken 费率档重新计费（一阶近似）
fee_shadow.rule_en: Per slot, from this experiment's fills only (no carry-over from earlier experiments, no pooling across slots): each fill's tier is assessed BEFORE it, from the slot's filled notional in the prior rolling 30 days; fee = notional x taker bp, HALF_UP to the cent.
fee_shadow.rule_zh: 逐槽、只用本实验自己的成交（不继承旧实验、不跨槽合并）：每笔成交之前，按本槽过去滚动 30 天的成交额评定费率档；费用 = 成交额 × taker 费率，四舍五入到分。

schedule.assessed_wording: Discount tiers are assessed after every trade, so you get your discounts when you earn them.
schedule.basis: Spot 30-Day Vol (USD) OR AoP (USD): the better of the two applies
disclosures: The frozen config's source_wording (checked 2026-09-19) quotes only the first four rows; they agree with this table.
The review analyst's taker rows of 2026-09-23 ($0 to $2.5M+: 80/60/38/35/30/25/22/20/18/15 bp) agree with this table; the page also lists Tier 11, Tier 12 and Pro 1-5, recorded here.

The same page carries a second spot table (a maker-rebate programme on select lower-liquidity pairs) whose maker column differs (0.38% down to -0.02%); its taker column is identical. The shadow uses taker only, so it is unaffected.

Assets on Platform (AoP) is not modelled: the shadow uses the slot's 30-day volume only. AoP first counts at $20K (Tier 3), twice a slot's principal; a slot that grew past it would be over-charged here, never under-charged.
schedule.modelled: taker only: every arena fill takes liquidity (immediate-or-cancel against the observed book), so only the taker column is ever used; the maker column is recorded for completeness and never applied
schedule.volume_wording: Volume generated with Instant Buy does not count towards your 30 day volume incentives.

rule.rank_rule: hard gates first; then sort by (median 24h USD turnover desc, median spread asc, candidate id asc); the first active_limit are ACTIVE; a member of the previous version keeps its seat while it still passes the gates and ranks within active_limit + hysteresis_rank_band; ties by candidate id

turnover_gate.basis: median rolling-24h ticker turnover over the version's sample window (the pool gate's own input)

valuation.note: equity = USD cash + sum(qty x last trade within mark_max_age_s); an older or missing mark makes the slot UNPRICED (equity NULL, unscorable) - never 0, never a silent stale price. The 00:00 UTC boundary uses the newest observation at or before boundary + grace; processing time is recorded separately.

fees.charged_on: quote-currency notional of each fill, HALF_UP to the cent, deducted from cash at fill time; never double-counted with spread or slippage
